description: Modular grid-snapping curation-station kit — tiling walls, step-stages, plinths, pillars, and a composer that stages 1-5 artifacts on the 1 m grid. Shares the HangarKit sci-fi-lab look.

station_wall.name: Station Wall (modular)
station_wall.description: A grid-modular backing wall exactly length_cells metres wide (1 m per cell) with optional start/end caps, so sections butt edge-to-edge on the grid and read as one continuous wall.

parameters.length_cells: Wall length in 1 m grid cells (int, default 2)
parameters.lit_seam: Emissive seam line along the top (bool)

station_stage.name: Station Stage (step deck)
station_stage.description: A grid-modular raised deck exactly width_cells x depth_cells metres, with a panelled skirt and caution-striped front lip — the platform a curated set stands on.

parameters.width_cells: Stage width in 1 m cells (int, default 5)
parameters.depth_cells: Stage depth in 1 m cells (int, default 3)
parameters.hazard_edge: Caution stripe on the front lip (bool)

station_plinth.name: Station Plinth (display column)
station_plinth.description: A grid-modular display column (1x1 or 2x2 cells) with a tray cap at reach height — one artifact stands on each.

parameters.top_height: Cap-top height where the artifact sits (default 1.0 m)

station_pillar.name: Station Pillar (corner column)
station_pillar.description: A grid-modular square column claiming one cell, with a lit accent groove and base/capital — frames a station's corners.

parameters.post_width: Shaft width, fits inside a 1 m cell (default 0.42)
parameters.readout_face: Small framed readout on the +Z face (bool)

curation_station.name: Curation Station (composer)
curation_station.description: The composer: give it 1-5 artifact lookup-names and it assembles a whole curation bay on the 1 m grid — step-stage, a plinth per item, a tiling backing wall with caps, framing pillars, and each artifact grounded inert on its plinth.

parameters.artifacts: Array of 1-5 artifact lookup-names to curate

station_cabinet.name: Station Cabinet (storage / display)
station_cabinet.description: A grid-modular display/storage cabinet (width_cells x 1 m) with a tinted glass front and lit internal shelves — cabinets line up cell-to-cell as a glowing back wall of stored specimens.

parameters.width_cells: Cabinet width in 1 m cells (int, default 2)

station_barrier.name: Station Barrier (front rail)
station_barrier.description: A grid-modular front barrier (length_cells x 1 m) of posts with a low panel or rail and a caution base — marks the front edge of the stage: stand back, look, do not cross.

parameters.length_cells: Run length in 1 m cells (int, default 4)

station_panel.name: Station Panel (wall info screen)
station_panel.description: A grid-modular wall-mounted info panel (width_cells x 1 m) showing crisp 2D-in-3D text (a title + lines) on a dark face — mounts flat on a station_wall to caption the bay.

parameters.width_cells: Panel width in 1 m cells (int, default 2)

station_bench.name: Station Bench (workbench)
station_bench.description: A grid-modular worktable (length_cells x depth_cells) with a top at working height, apron, legs, and optional drawers — the flat way to present a set, laid out rather than raised on plinths.

parameters.length_cells: Bench length in 1 m cells (int, default 2)
parameters.depth_cells: Bench depth in 1 m cells (int, default 1)

station_crates.name: Station Crates (supply stack)
station_crates.description: A grid-modular cluster of stacked crates and a canister with hazard labels, filling one cell — the lived-in back-of-house clutter that makes a clean stage believable.
